title: 轻轻向右
description: 透明水粉中，成人在低位三点支撑下轻伸向右侧大点。

art_direction.medium: editorial geometric illustration with credible adult proportions
art_direction.scene: An original gouache illustration shows a fictional adult making a short rightward reach on a low slightly slabby bouldering panel. Both feet stand on broad lemon-yellow footholds, the left hand stays on a large jug, and the right hand reaches toward a nearby matching hold. Keep the torso upright and the movement easy, with no extreme stretching. Compose a medium-wide view from the climber's left so the foot placements, lightly angled wall, and broad empty crash mat are unmistakable. Use opaque brushwork, sunlit cream walls, and a small chalk bag worn at the waist. All clothing is opaque; the scene contains no text, brands, or risky height.
